profile.headline: Software Developer || Gamer || Texas Football || Vetran
profile.summary:
With over eight years of service as a firefighter and a team leader in the US Navy, I have developed a strong sense of discipline, courage, and commitment that I apply to every challenge I face. I have proven my ability to make swift and decisive decisions in high-pressure situations, to lead and motivate a diverse team, and to implement innovative training and performance improvement initiatives.

Now, as a student software developer at Tech Elevator, I am pursuing my passion for creating dynamic web-based software systems using Java and SQL. I am eager to learn from experienced instructors and peers, to apply my skills to real-world projects, and to contribute to the software development field with innovative and boundary-pushing solutions. My goal is to join a company that values teamwork, creativity, and excellence, and that offers opportunities for continuous learning and growth.

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description: 14-week full-stack coding bootcamp learning how to create dynamic web-based software systems using Java  providing 800+ hours of development education and application.

positions.title: Firefighter
positions.description:
- Led a team of 8 junior firefighters in daily fire station operations, fostering a culture of discipline and 
  teamwork.

- Served as the on-scene leader for active emergencies, demonstrating strong decision-making skills and 
   ensuring efficient and effective emergency response

- Implemented innovative training initiatives resulting in a 20% improvement in team performance and 
   responses

- Reduced response time by 30 seconds & successfully led firefighting teams in extinguishing 50 fires 
   while guiding effective rescue operations, utilizing firefighting equipment, emergency response 
   protocols, decision-making skills, & team management

- Managed on-scene operations for fires, medical emergencies, & accidents, utilizing risk assessment, 
   first aid, emergency protocols, communication devices, & emergency vehicles

positions.title: Weekend General Manager
positions.description:
- Lead Sales Team: Supervise and motivate the sales team to achieve membership sales goals.
   Membership Sales: Actively engage in selling memberships and promoting the club's services.

- Customer Service: Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through excellent service.
   Staff Training: Train new sales staff on sales techniques and club offerings.

- Performance Monitoring: Monitor team performance and provide feedback and coaching.

projects.title: Tenmo Banking App
projects.description: Web-based payment platform centered around a RESTful API server, with backend elements such as MVC architecture and database table implementation

projects.title: Vending Machine App
projects.description: Application for a vending machine featuring a refined command-line interface, demonstrating a sophisticated hierarchy of modular superclasses and subclasses. This application includes efficient parsing and file management capabilities, enhancing its data handling efficiency. Its reliability is established through comprehensive JUnit unit testing, guaranteeing its stability and consistent performance.
